d: Ramayana: Part 1 has taken global cinemas by storm with its ₹4,000 crore scale, starring Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Yash as Ravana, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and music by Oscar legends Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, this monumental Indian epic is backed by producer Namit Malhotra—the visionary founder of Prime Focus Studios and the eight-time Academy Award-winning VFX powerhouse DNEG. In this episode of Rough Copy by Khabargaon, we uncover the untold story of how Namit Malhotra went from mortgaging his family home in a small Mumbai garage with a single Apple Mac…
